scheme_name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India Post-Senior Secondary Courses (Post-10+2 Courses)
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands as notified under the Scheduled Tribes Order No. 58.
Student must be a domicile of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
Student must have passed Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board or any higher examination from a recognized university.
Scholarship is applicable only for regular, full‑time post‑senior secondary courses (graduate, postgraduate, diploma, degree, M.Phil, Ph.D., post‑doctoral, professional/technical courses).
Student must maintain good conduct and regular attendance as certified by the Head of the Institution.
Any change of course or institution without prior approval of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration may lead to cancellation of the scholarship.
Scholarship may be cancelled for providing false information, and the amount may be recovered.
If the student discontinues studies, the scholarship amount may be refunded at the discretion of the Administration.
Scholarship is renewable annually subject to promotion to the next class and meeting examination requirements.
benefits_summary: An additional scholarship of ₹1,000 per month payable for ten months, directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account.
